title: Low-degree learning sample count
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and let the rational learning parameter $\delta$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq \tfrac12$. The prescribed sample count is $2^\ell$ times the sum of the number of degree-at-most-$\ell$ monomials on $n$ coordinates and the number of failure bits associated with $\delta$.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the monomial count and failure-bit count.
